title: draw/flow/win .log.bin goldens are byte-identical while their .t1 goldens differ completely
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/draw.log.bin b/goldens/draw.log.bin
index b0a2f10..b4bc1c2 100644
diff --git a/goldens/flow.log.bin b/goldens/flow.log.bin
index b0a2f10..b4bc1c2 100644
diff --git a/goldens/win.log.bin b/goldens/win.log.bin
index b0a2f10..b4bc1c2 100644
goldens/draw.t1: -1 07782c8ccf13ffde
goldens/flow.t1: -1 1cac863a4892477c
goldens/win.t1: -1 e85e2004465de0cf
detail: Three demos whose .t1 files record entirely different per-tick hashes produce identical binary logs, before AND after this change. Every other demo has a unique .log.bin hash. The binary goldens cannot distinguish these three scenarios.
recommended_fix: Verify the binary logger emits per-demo content. If draw/flow/win .log.bin should differ, regenerate the goldens and investigate why the binary logs converge while the text logs diverge.

title: boot/qos_contention/qos_emphasis/sla update only .log.bin — no .t1 counterpart in the diff
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/boot.log.bin b/goldens/boot.log.bin
index 7cdfaa8..8f0942a 100644
diff --git a/goldens/qos_contention.log.bin b/goldens/qos_contention.log.bin
index e62942d..b5c9adf 100644
diff --git a/goldens/qos_emphasis.log.bin b/goldens/qos_emphasis.log.bin
index 1f1c571..3d3d6f9 100644
diff --git a/goldens/sla.log.bin b/goldens/sla.log.bin
index bdbec79..c3a132d 100644
detail: Every other demo in this chunk updates its .t1 and .log.bin goldens in lockstep (catalog_hash changed for all); these four update only the binary. If text goldens exist for them, they were not regenerated and will go stale against the new catalog.
recommended_fix: Confirm whether these four demos emit .t1 logs; regenerate and commit matching .t1 goldens for any that do, or document why the asymmetry is expected.

title: Terminal freeze-tails in lose.t1/win.t1 mask any post-game-over state mutation
detail: All trailing ticks after the terminal tick share one identical hash in both old and new goldens. Any state change after game end would leave these lines untouched, making late-tick bugs invisible to the golden harness.
recommended_fix: Confirm the freeze represents a deliberate terminal-state invariant. If the sim can still mutate state post-terminal, add an explicit terminal-marker assertion to the harness rather than relying on hash equality.
